text: on-exit ExecutableEntity A RunnableEntity or a BswSchedulableEntity that is triggered by a SwcModeSwitchEvent respectively a BswModeSwitchEvent with ModeActivationKind ‘exit’ is triggered on exiting the mode. It is called on-exit ExecutableEntity. See also section 4.4.1.

targets.why: SwcModeSwitchEvent starts entity when mode exited
BswModeSwitchEvent starts BSW entity on exit
